model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various models across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The x-axis lists these categories, while the y-axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50 to 62 in increments of 2. The bars are grouped by category and colored according to the legend, which includes six models: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. Each category contains six bars, one for each model, with DAPO+Self-reflection having the highest accuracy in all three categories, at 56%, 57%, and 61% for Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, respectively. The lowest accuracy is observed in PPO for Mathverse and MMLU, at approximately 53% and 54.5%, respectively, while in Physics, it is around 56.5%. The models are not sorted by accuracy within each category, but the chart allows for a comparison of the relative performance of each model across the three categories.
model_annotations.Chinese:
该柱状图展示了不同模型在三个特定任务中的准确率。图中横轴显示了类别，标签分别为“Mathverse”、“MMLU”和“Physics”；类别按字母顺序排列。纵轴标记为“准确率（%）”，数值范围从50到62，刻度为线性，每2个单位标记一次。

每个类别包含六个柱状图，分成三组，每组包含两个柱状图，并根据图例进行颜色编码。第一组柱状图以各种蓝色阴影表示，标签为“DAPO”和“DAPO+自我反思”；第二组柱状图以橙色和绿色阴影表示（GRPO和SRPO），第三组柱状图以绿色阴影表示，标签为“PPO”和“PPO+自我反思”。在“Mathverse”类别中，柱状图的准确率范围从约53%到56%，最长的柱状图是“DAPO+自我反思”（约56%），最短的是“PPO”（约53%）。在“MMLU”类别中，准确率范围从约53.5%到57%，“DAPO+自我反思”再次成为最长的柱状图（约57%），而“PPO”仍然是最短的（约53.5%）。在“Physics”类别中，准确率范围从约54.5%到61%，“DAPO+自我反思”是最长的柱状图（约61%），“PPO”仍然是最短的（约54.5%）。

总的来说，该图表显示了准确率随着类别的变化而变化，每个类别中六个柱状图按一致的视觉排列分组和标记。该图表中的柱状图未按特定顺序排序，但“DAPO+自我反思”在所有类别中始终具有最高的准确率，而“PPO”在所有类别中始终具有最低的准确率。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of various models across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the categories, while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranging from 50 to 62 in increments of 2. The chart features six models, each represented by a distinct color and pattern, as indicated by the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (light blue), SRPO (orange), GRPO (yellow), PPO+Self-reflection (green), and PPO (light green). Each category contains a grouped set of bars, with the height of the bars representing the accuracy of the corresponding model. The accuracy values range from approximately 53 to 61. The bars are grouped by category, with the models sorted in the same order within each group. The tallest bar in the Mathverse category is around 56, while in the MMLU category, it is approximately 57, and in the Physics category, it is around 61. Notably, DAPO+Self-reflection and GRPO consistently appear among the top-performing models across the three categories. The chart provides a visual representation of the relative performance of each model across the different categories.
model_annotations.German: The diagram presents a comparison of the accuracy percentages of various models across three subjects: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists these subjects in a fixed order, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% in increments of 2%. Each subject is associated with six bars, representing different models, which are grouped together and distinguished by color as indicated in the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (light blue), SRPO (red), GRPO (orange), PPO+Self-reflection (green), and PPO (light green). For each subject, the bars are arranged in the same order, corresponding to the models listed in the legend. The approximate accuracy percentages for the models are as follows: for Mathverse, the values range from around 53% for PPO to 56% for DAPO+Self-reflection; for MMLU, the values range from around 54.5% for PPO to 57% for DAPO+Self-reflection; and for Physics, the values range from around 55% for PPO to 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection. The bars are not sorted in any particular order within each subject group, and there is no apparent visual highlighting of specific bars.
